identity: A Palestinian primary-school science / social-studies worksheet (Arabic, roughly grades 2-4), one exercise item per line. Two item formats are interleaved on the same page: (a) true/false items, a declarative statement followed by the two answer options صح and خطأ; (b) three-option multiple-choice items, a stem with its blank at the end followed by three bare answer options and no صح/خطأ. Content: which plant parts are eaten (leaves, stems, roots, fruits), rain-fed crops, compass directions and map orientation, neighbourly cooperation, and buying local rather than occupation products. This is doctrine §J (worksheet, layout-driven, 3-10 token units) crossed with §S (MCQ stem/option) — my strongest register by a wide margin (F1 99.3, 99.2, 98.0 on the three prior worksheets).
law: The unit is a LAYOUT SLOT, not a sentence. Each line is one item and splits into exactly [stem] plus one segment per answer option. The stem swallows everything that qualifies it — و-lists (واللون والحجم), spaced و (الأوراق و الساق), conditional إذا-clauses, relative التي-clauses, and the completing NP of a true/false statement — and it runs as far forward as possible, ending on the last token before the first true option even when that token is a bare function word such as من, exactly as gold ended a stem on the copula هو in doc_1c49614cd6bc @118. Each answer option is exactly ONE segment however many tokens it spans, so قصب السكر, زيت الزيتون, دوار الشمس and منتجات الاحتلال are single options (LAW 3, S2). صح and خطأ are two separate segments, not one — confirmed on a lexically identical gold, doc_056d9b714661 @10: القمباز من التراث وترتديه النساء ‖ صح ‖ خطأ ‖. Every <NL> is immediately preceded by a boundary; no <NL> ever carries one. No connective is ever a reason to cut here.
reasoning: CALIBRATION FIRST. Every error I have logged in this register — doc_00b450a96684 @18, doc_056d9b714661 @10, doc_1c49614cd6bc @118 — is the same error in the same direction: I ended the stem TOO EARLY and cut inside it. Three instances, zero in the opposite direction. That one-directional signal is what decides every fork below in favour of the longer stem, and it is a stronger guide here than my global batch-2 weld default. || SITE 1 — the T/F-versus-MCQ trap at line 19 (@176-184, من النباتات التي لا توكل ثمارها التفاح صح خطأ). Its surface is an exact clone of lines 17 and 18 (@157-164, @166-174), which are genuine three-option MCQs, so التفاح presents itself as option 1. It is not. The presence of صح/خطأ defines the item type, and no item can offer a plant name and a true/false pair as alternatives in the same slot list. التفاح is the completing NP of the statement — a FALSE statement, since apples are eaten, which is precisely what makes it a usable T/F item with answer خطأ. Stem therefore runs to @182 التفاح, then صح, then خطأ. The same logic keeps الفجل والجزر (@25-26) inside the stem at line 3 and البرتقال-style lists out of it only where صح/خطأ are absent. || SITE 2 — stems ending on a bare preposition: @132 من in يصنع الصابون من, and @143 من in يصنع الخبز و البسكويت من. The preposition governs all three options jointly, so it cannot belong to option 1; in the printed original the layout colon falls immediately after it (A4: a layout colon IS a boundary). I have direct gold precedent for a stem terminating on a bare function word — doc_1c49614cd6bc @118 ended a 20-token stem on the copula هو. Cut at من in both, hi. The competing reading, that the stem ends at الصابون and option 1 is من زيت الزيتون, would leave options 2 and 3 without the preposition and is rejected. || SITE 3 — multi-token options. قصب السكر (@116-117), زيت الزيتون (@133-134), دوار الشمس (@135-136) and منتجات الاحتلال (@154-155) are each ONE option, not two. Two independent checks agree. First, each is a fixed lexical compound, and قصب السكر appears twice elsewhere in this very document as an unsplit unit inside stems (@10-11 and @101-102), which is internal proof the document treats it as one name. Second, every MCQ line here offers exactly three options, and that count only comes out right if these compounds occupy single slots. LAW 3 and S2 both forbid cutting inside an option. || SITE 4 — the one genuine fork, line 16 (@148-155, من الواجب شراء المنتجات المحلية المستوردة منتجات الاحتلال). Reading A: stem ends @151 المنتجات, options = المحلية / المستوردة / منتجات الاحتلال. Reading B: stem ends @150 شراء, options = المنتجات المحلية / المستوردة / منتجات الاحتلال. Note first that @152, @153 and @155 are boundaries under BOTH readings, so only the @150-versus-@151 choice is actually live and only one boundary is at risk. Reading B makes option 2 a headless adjective while option 1 carries its own head — internally inconsistent as an option set. Reading A puts the blank in the adjective slot after المنتجات, which is the natural worksheet frame (buy ___ products), and Reading A is the longer stem, which is exactly where my one-directional error signal points. I take @151 and mark it med — this is the single site I expect to lose if I lose one. || SITE 5 — are صح and خطأ one segment or two? Two. doc_056d9b714661 @10 is a lexically identical gold and splits them, and doc_00b450a96684 @18 splits the equivalent غيرصحيح ‖ صحيح ‖. Settled, hi, applied 22 times across the eleven T/F lines. || SITE 6 — the negative check, which is where batch 2 killed me. I deliberately placed NO boundary at any و in this document: واللون والحجم (@5-6), وتنمو (@31), والجزر (@26), and the spaced و tokens at @95, @141 and @188. LAW 1 as revised says و is never a reason to cut, and J6 gold specifically welded a spaced و inside a stem (عبرت هبة الشارع و الإشارة الضوئية حمراء هذا السلوك ‖). Likewise no boundary before the trailing conditional إذا منعنا عنه الماء (@33-36) — LAW 4, a subordinate clause that follows its main clause belongs to it — and none before the relative التي clauses that open most stems. || VERIFICATION. 67 boundaries over 195 tokens, mean unit 2.9 tokens, consistent with §J's layout-driven 3-10 given that most options are one token. All 19 <NL> tokens (@9, 19, 29, 39, 49, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110, 120, 129, 138, 147, 156, 165, 175, 185) are immediately preceded by a boundary; no boundary index lands on an <NL>; the final token @194 خطأ is covered.
